coverage_matrix.key_feature: Online Customer Booking Engine & Account Portal

flows: Staff Vehicle Check-In, Damage/Fuel Reconciliation & Final Settlement
Staff Vehicle Check-In, Damage/Fuel Reconciliation & Final Settlement

gaps.message: Elena's overdue journey states a '30-minute grace period' and a '$75/hr late penalty', while key_features ('Check-In, Automated Surcharges & Settlement Engine' / 'Active Fleet Dashboard & Overdue Tracking'), the overdue user stories, and the prototype (FinancialFormulaBreakdown lateGraceMinutes=60) all define a 60-minute (1-hour) grace period and an hourly late fee capped at the vehicle's daily rate.
gaps.compensation_hint: Implement the 60-minute grace period everywhere; compute the hourly late fee from VehicleCategory.late_hourly_fee capped at the daily rate; render the 60-min grace and cap in /admin/rentals/:rentalId/overdue and /counter/settlement/:rentalId.

gaps.message: Booking protection tiers (Basic/Standard/Full) and add-ons (child seat, additional driver, roadside assistance, prepaid fuel) are required by key_features, the booking stories and the /booking/configure prototype, but no column or model persists the selection. RentalCharge's enum allows insurance_protection/equipment_addon, but nothing stores which tier/add-ons the renter chose.
gaps.compensation_hint: Add a `protection_tier` string column to Rental; persist tier + add-on selections as RentalCharge line items (charge_type insurance_protection / equipment_addon) on the reserved Rental; drive pricing from RateRule/VehicleCategory.

gaps.message: Acceptance criterion 'Guest users can complete checkout and booking confirmation without an account' conflicts with the schema: Rental.customer_profile_id is required and CustomerProfile.user_id is required, so a renter without an account cannot be represented.
gaps.compensation_hint: Make CustomerProfile.user_id nullable and add `full_name` and `email` columns so a guest CustomerProfile can be created at checkout; keep Rental.customer_profile_id required and resolve guest bookings through a public booking endpoint (Extra).

gaps.message: Sitemap page /account/profile (Profile & Documents) has no user story and no acceptance criterion describing its behavior.
gaps.compensation_hint: Add compensated ACs: an authenticated customer can view/update name, email and phone; see driver's-license verification status; and unauthenticated hits redirect to /login.

gaps.message: /account/profile is protected in the sitemap but is not included in the 'Unauthenticated users are redirected to /login' AC, which lists only /account/dashboard, /account/bookings and /account/billing.
gaps.compensation_hint: Extend the authenticated guard to every /account/* route; add a compensated AC and set roles ['customer'] in the UI handoff.

gaps.message: Parent hub routes /booking, /counter and /admin appear in the sitemap and have prototype pages, but no acceptance criterion describes their landing content.
gaps.compensation_hint: Add compensated ACs for each hub: /booking funnel entry, /counter KPI + dispatch board, /admin KPI + operational alert board.

gaps.message: navigation_design references destinations with no sitemap route and no prototype page: 'How It Works' and 'Support' primary links, plus admin System items Branch Settings, Staff Access Control and Stripe Gateway Settings.
gaps.compensation_hint: Treat as out-of-scope nav stubs — render as static anchors on the landing page and omit admin System routes; no PRD story or AC covers them. Documented in .rhino-plan.md.

gaps.message: Vehicle.status vocabulary conflicts across the PRD: key_features/design use 'Available, Reserved, On-Rent, Maintenance, Detailing' while sample_data uses 'available, rented, cleaning, maintenance'.
gaps.compensation_hint: Normalize to the enum available|reserved|rented|maintenance|cleaning|overdue on Vehicle; document the mapping (rented = On-Rent, cleaning = Detailing) and use the normalized values in seeds, badges and availability logic.

gaps.message: Rental.status mixes booking and rental vocabulary with no declared enum (stories/sample_data use reserved, confirmed, active, overdue, completed).
gaps.compensation_hint: Declare the enum reserved|confirmed|active|overdue|completed|cancelled on Rental and validate it; document where each transition occurs (checkout → confirmed, key handover → active, grace expiry → overdue, settlement → completed).

gaps.message: The PRD requires open public customer sign-up (/signup) with email verification, but Rhino v4 registration is invitation-token based (POST /api/auth/register consumes an invitation token) — there is no open signup endpoint.
gaps.compensation_hint: Implement a custom customer registration + email-verification flow as an Extra (public registration endpoint + mailer), or seed customer accounts for demos; document that staff onboarding uses Rhino invitations.

gaps.message: sample_data 'users' rows carry Devise/DeviseTokenAuth columns (uid, provider, encrypted_password, sign_in_count, approved, profile_completed, allow_password_change) that do not exist in the Rhino v4 auth model (has_secure_password + has_secure_token :api_token). The story-1 AC 'The data model stores approved' therefore has no backing column.
gaps.compensation_hint: Use Rhino Bearer api_token auth and ignore the Devise-only columns; add a `users.approved` boolean (default true) via a DriveFlow extension migration to back the 'approved' AC, and set it false for self-registered customers pending email verification.

hints_for_planner: Use role_registry ids verbatim in _roles.yaml and ui-handoff.json roles arrays: customer, counter_agent, fleet_manager.
Normalize late-return logic to a 60-minute grace period with an hourly fee from VehicleCategory.late_hourly_fee capped at the daily rate (FLOW_JOURNEY_MISMATCH).
Add Rental.protection_tier and persist protection/add-on selections as RentalCharge line items (DATA_MODEL_UX_MISMATCH).
Make CustomerProfile.user_id nullable and add full_name/email so guest checkout works (DATA_MODEL_UX_MISMATCH).
Declare Vehicle.status and Rental.status enums and use the normalized values in seeds/badges (DATA_MODEL_UX_MISMATCH).
Implement customer self-registration + email verification as an Extra because Rhino v4 registration is invitation-token based (DATA_MODEL_UX_MISMATCH).
Add users.approved boolean via a DriveFlow extension migration to back the 'approved' data-model AC.
Add compensated ACs + handoff entries for /account/profile, /booking, /counter, /admin (SITEMAP_PAGE_NO_AC / PROTECTED_ROUTE_NO_AUTH_AC).
Extend the '/account/* redirect to /login' guard to include /account/profile.
Treat How It Works / Support and admin System nav items as documented out-of-scope stubs (PRD_PROTOTYPE_ROUTE_GAP).
